supersedes.reason: Pre-inference baseline hardening: repair the SHA baseline generator's missing hash-helper import and remove every private-label argument or file access from the public-text TF-IDF generator. Public episodes, prompts, shard boundaries, systems, and scoring are unchanged.

evaluation_unit.headline_sample: one predeclared pass@1 response per episode
evaluation_unit.fresh_chat_boundary: one new consumer chat for each fixed five-episode shard
evaluation_unit.shared_context_disclosure: Five episodes share one fresh-chat context and reasoning allowance; results estimate this exact deployment protocol, not one-item model ability.
evaluation_unit.itemwise_scoring: A complete five-key response envelope preserves every budget-valid item independently. A wrong-size, duplicate, or out-of-pool selection zeros only that item.
evaluation_unit.whole_call_invalidity: No complete five-key envelope, a tool/search action, a timeout, or a terminal transport failure zeros every episode in that call.
evaluation_unit.retry_policy: At most one retry in a new fresh chat only for an explicit provider/platform error before any substantive output; preserve both attempts. No retry for timeout, refusal, partial output, malformed output, or apparent mathematical error.

required_per_call_evidence: verbatim raw response bytes, including an empty file when no response was produced
fresh-chat ordinal and fixed call ID
displayed model and reasoning-mode labels recorded verbatim
required_per_row_screenshots: visible displayed deployment and mode before the first chat
visible displayed deployment and mode after the final chat
manual_chat.per_call_screenshot: optional corroboration; not required for validity
consumer_unknowns: silent routing changes not exposed in the UI

systems.reasoning_setting: highest user-selectable reasoning mode; exact UI label recorded verbatim
Thinking/DeepThink enabled; exact UI label recorded verbatim

analytic_uniform_random.role: exact analytic reference, not a sampled run

sha256_random_portfolio.method: rank each in-pool candidate by SHA256(seed NUL episode_id NUL candidate_id), take the first three

parameters.portfolio_objective: sum over targets of maximum selected-candidate similarity

consumer_chatgpt_gpt56_sol_decomposition.reasoning_setting: same highest user-selectable reasoning mode as the core ChatGPT row
consumer_chatgpt_gpt56_sol_decomposition.condition: ordered predicted support then deterministic exhaustive optimizer
consumer_chatgpt_gpt56_sol_decomposition.optimizer: exhaustively maximize predicted target coverage over all 560 triples; lexicographically smallest sorted maximizing triple
consumer_chatgpt_gpt56_sol_decomposition.subset_rule: take the 20 episode IDs with smallest SHA256(seed NUL episode_id), then restore original public order
consumer_chatgpt_gpt56_sol_decomposition.if_started: complete and freeze all four chats, or explicitly abandon/exclude before label unseal while preserving every partial artifact

deployment_substitution_policy.before_first_chat: A visibly unavailable or renamed deployment/mode may be replaced only through a timestamped superseding protocol and substitution receipt frozen before that row's first blind chat.
deployment_substitution_policy.after_first_chat: Stop the row; never splice labels or modes. A replacement uses a new system ID and restarts all twelve chats while labels remain sealed.

closure_policy.mandatory_core: Both complete N=60 consumer rows and both deterministic captures must be frozen before label unseal.
closure_policy.optional_arm: Absence cannot invalidate the core. Before unseal its disposition must be COMPLETED_FROZEN, NOT_STARTED_EXCLUDED, or ABANDONED_EXCLUDED_WITH_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE.

development_exclusions.all_codex_cli_rows: development-only and excluded from the blind main table
development_exclusions.all_local_open_weight_rows: development-only and excluded from the blind main table

disclosures.assistant_involvement: Codex agents assisted benchmark design, code, and manuscript development; GPT-5.6 Sol is also evaluated.
disclosures.defensible_independence_claim: The deterministic builder reads no blind predictions or labels, and frozen public bytes precede manual blind capture. No claim is made that model output did not influence project development.
disclosures.self_evaluation_limitation: Provider-family overlap and model-assisted benchmark development are limitations.
